potential_unspecified_behavior: The shared ToolbarMenu now draws the value of a quiet menu with truncateValue without truncation (`whitespace-nowrap`). This affects the Video and Reading shelf-page sort menus, which no touch point or invariant names directly.
Clips Home shelves now read すべて見る in ja because they share the string with the Library.
regression_risks: A long sort value on a Video/Reading shelf-page header at narrow widths can no longer ellipsize, because the quiet+truncateValue span is nowrap. The actions cell is min-w-0 and takes its own row below sm, but a value that is too long could still overflow. app-header e2e measurements cover this; I did not run them.
The video-app.html fixture's quietMenuValue (`min-w-0 truncate`) already differed from the real TargetMenu value class (`min-w-[2.5em] truncate`) before this change.
test_coverage: No fixture or parity test models the quiet+truncateValue branch of ToolbarMenu. readingVideoLayoutFixtureParity renders only showLabel/filled/fullWidth variants (readingVideoLayoutFixtureParity.test.tsx:307-322).
